swaps.desc: To keep burning the flames of faith, this society's ruling priesthood embodies the radiant light of holy fire, lighting the way for their followers and cleansing evil from society.

swaps.name: Fortune Broker
swaps.desc: With the stars as their guide, these thought leaders coordinate the spiritual enterprises of the empire.

swaps.name: Tech Visionary

swaps.desc: The right to rule is determined not by inheritance, but by the measure of one's worth; and how better to measure your worth than by the sum total of the balance sheet?

swaps.name: High Pilgrim
swaps.desc: §LPilgrims have been the lifeblood of our society since time immemorial. To complete the sacred pilgrimage and be blessed by the deities is our birthright.§!
